title: Seeded-defect ground truth for one evaluation fixture (EVALUATION-PLAN §3, §4.1)
description: One file per fixture at evals/fixtures/<name>/ground-truth.json. A detection matches a defect when it carries the defect's criterion (or one of its also_criteria) on the defect's route, and, when the scorer compares locations, the defect's selector. Route "*" means every route in the fixture's fixture.json. Keys starting with _ are notes for people.

clean.description: true only for a control fixture with no seeded defect; every detection on it is a false positive.

provenance.description: How the ground truth was set: who seeded it, and the status of the two-labeller review that EVALUATION-PLAN §3 requires for analytical defects.

criterionId.description: A QUALITY-BAR or knowledge-file rule ID (TYP-06, A11Y-13, I18N-14, CMP-05), a tell (SLP-07), a Nielsen heuristic (H1-H10), a cognitive-walkthrough question (CW-Q1-CW-Q4) or a WCAG 2.2 success criterion (1.4.3).

checkName.description: A `uie audit` check name (ARCHITECTURE §7.2), or lint for `uie lint`.

also_criteria.description: Other IDs a correct detection of the same defect may carry (for example the rule ID behind a WCAG criterion).

kind.description: deterministic: a script should detect it (uie audit, uie lint or uie journey); judged: it needs an isolated evaluator, critic or auditor.

route.description: The URL path served from the fixture folder, without the query string; * for every route.

state.description: A state name from fixture.json for that route, or * for every state.

selector.description: A CSS selector for the main element, or null for a page-level or missing-element defect.

file.description: The source file, relative to the fixture folder, where the defect is authored (used to match uie lint hits).

expected_severity_band.description: [lowest, highest] mean severity a sound rating should land in, on the 0-4 scale.

expected_check.description: The primary check that should detect a deterministic defect; null for a judged one.

also_detected_by.description: Further checks expected to report the same defect.

seeded_from.description: evaluation-plan when the defect is one of the examples listed for this fixture in EVALUATION-PLAN §3; added for the extra defects of the same family; found for a problem the fixture did not seed that a second labeller reproduced and at least two independent reviews reported (see the fixture's provenance).

refines.description: For a found defect: the seeded defect whose construction it shares, read for a different harm (the same element and moment). Recall against the seeded set counts it toward that defect, so rounds graded before and after it was added stay comparable.

found_evidence.description: For a found defect: who reproduced it and which reviews reported it.

cw.description: For walkthrough defects: where the cognitive walkthrough of a journey should record the failure.
